name: TCL BeyondTV (Poland)
summary: TCL BeyondTV in Poland ships with TCL analytics, promo rows and a use-tracking cleaner. TidyTV is a free phone app that turns them off, with undo.
intro: This Polish TCL runs Android TV 9 and ships with TCL analytics, a bug report uploader, partner app attribution and a partner app auto installer. The home screen carries recommendation rows, T-Channel and TCL promo rows, and TCL adds a message and promo box and retail demo stickers. A TV Guard cleaner and a TCL app store are also listed.

The list was applied in groups with a screenshot after each, then rebooted once. Home, the Inputs menu, the remote's Source and Settings buttons and Netflix worked. It has not been lived with for days. TidyTV saves a backup first and never deletes anything.
keep: Live TV and the tuner and HDMI input services
The source manager and the remote's key services
The firmware updater, kept by choice
notes: A TCL notes app is turned back on by the firmware at every boot, so it is left alone.

faq.q: Will the voice button still work on my TCL BeyondTV?
faq.a: Not with the default list. It turns off Google voice search and the mic button, plus TCL's Assistant bridge. Switch them back on in the app if you use voice.
Miracast and TCL's T-Cast phone link are on the list and are switched off. Switch them back on if you use them.

faq.q: Will it stop the ads on the home screen?
faq.a: It turns off the recommendation rows, the T-Channel and promo rows and the TCL message and promo box.
